payload.reason: The evidence provides clear insights into the practical applications of measuring performance using MAP at gold-k, particularly in evaluating entity set expansion (ESE) methods in user-generated text.

claims.text: Measuring MAP at gold-k helps evaluate ESE methods in scenarios with diverse entity types, improving performance assessment in user-generated text.
The MAP at gold-k metric adapts to varying concept sizes and provides a better estimate of recall, crucial for real-world applications.
Using MAP at gold-k allows for the inclusion of multifaceted, vague, and non-named entities, which are often overlooked in smaller k evaluations.
